data.title: Nursery place offer for Jonas – response needed
data.summary: Kita-Verbund Beispielkinder gGmbH offers a nursery place (Krippenplatz) for your son Jonas at Kita Sonnenblume starting 1 February 2027, with 35 hours of care per week, and asks you to accept or decline within 12 working days of the letter's date (19 November 2026).
data.explanation: This letter offers your son a nursery spot. You must tell the Kita whether you accept or decline the offer by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the letter's date counting only working days (public holidays excluded). If you do not respond in time, the place will be given to the next family on the waiting list. No payment is requested at this stage; simply reply using the phone number or email given on the letter.
